title: PlanEnvelope v0.1
description: Frozen common planning envelope for Phase 1 task T0101. Standards-compliant runtime validation is deferred to T0111.
$comment: The frozen envelope is declarative, provider-neutral, Moodle-light, and composable. It does not define downstream plan payloads.

plan_id.description: Stable hyphenated RFC UUID identity shared by revisions of one plan.

revision.description: Positive revision number identifying this particular plan revision.

plan_type.description: The plan family represented by content.

operation.description: The declarative create or update intent.

title.description: Human-readable title shown in a preview.

summary.description: Concise explanation of the intended change.

warnings.description: Planner-detected uncertainty or problems; an empty array means none were reported.

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions made by the planner; an empty array means none were reported.

content.description: Plan-specific payload boundary. T0101 intentionally permits an object without defining downstream fields.
